entries.jp: 井伊直弼を倒した龍馬達が\n京の都へと戻ってから\n十日が経とうとしている
entries.en:
Nearly ten days
had passed since
Ryoma and the
others defeated
Naosuke Ii and
returned to
Kyoto.

entries.jp: 親徳川の急先鋒だった\n井伊大老を失った\n徳川幕府は
entries.en:
Having lost Great
Elder Ii, the
spearhead of the
pro-Tokugawa
camp, the
Tokugawa
shogunate...

entries.jp: 急激に統治力を弱め\n今や　その天秤は\n倒幕に傾きつつある
entries.en:
...rapidly lost its
grip on power,
and now the
scales were
tipping toward its
overthrow.

entries.jp: そして――
entries.en: And then--

entries.jp:
泰平化を解かれた新選組の
隊士達からの熱い要望と
勝海舟の口添えにより
土方と沖田の　新選組への
復隊が決まった
entries.en:
Freed troopers'
fervent pleas and
a word from
Kaishu Katsu got
Hijikata and Okita
reinstated in the
Shinsengumi.

entries.jp: これで　本当の\n新選組の復活じゃ！
entries.en: Now the real\nShinsengumi's\nback for good!

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさんも\nソウちんも\n本当によかったなあ
entries.en: Hijizo-san and\nSo-chin, I'm real\nhappy for 'em!

entries.jp: とはいえ\nちょっと複雑です
entries.en: Even so, I have\nmixed feelings.

entries.jp: 未だ　私達は幕府の\nお尋ね者ですからね
entries.en: We're still wanted\nby the shogunate,\nafter all.

entries.jp: 表向きには　また\nあの二人と敵対しあう\nことになってしまいます
entries.en:
Officially, we'll
end up enemies
of those two all
over again.

entries.jp: 今までみたいに\n気軽に話すことも\nできなくなりますよ
entries.en:
We won't be able
to chat casually
like we have been
anymore.

entries.jp: だが　あの二人が\n正式に新選組に\n復帰すれば
entries.en:
But once those
two are officially
back in the
Shinsengumi...

entries.jp: 今までよりも\n格段に幕府の情報を\n集めやすくなるぜ
entries.en:
...gathering intel
on the shogunate
gets a whole lot
easier.

entries.jp: 井伊を操っていた\n徳川家の黒幕のことも\n何かわかるかもしれない
entries.en:
We might even
learn something
about the
Tokugawa
mastermind who
was pulling Ii's
strings.

entries.jp: ようやく　オレ様達に\n風が吹き始めたようだな
entries.en:
Looks like the
wind's finally
starting to blow
our way.

entries.jp: この機会を逃す\n手はないぜ
entries.en: We'd be fools to\nlet this chance\nslip by.

entries.jp: お登勢や～ん\n酒はないか？
entries.en: Otose-yaaan! Got\nany sake?

entries.jp: 一気に幕府を切り崩し\n倒幕の動きを推し進――
entries.en:
We'll tear down
the shogunate in
one go and push
the movement to
overthrow it
forw--

entries.jp: お登勢や～ん？\nお龍でもいいんじゃが\n酒を持ってきてくれ～！
entries.en:
Otose-yaaan?
Oryo'll do too!
Bring us some
sake!

entries.jp: 酒　酒　うるせえ\nオレ様は　真面目な\n話をしてるんだぞ
entries.en:
Sake, sake, shut
up already! Yours
truly is talking
about something
serious here!

entries.jp: そうは言っても\nめでたいぜよ！
entries.en: Even so, this calls\nfor a celebration!

entries.jp: これで　あの二人も\n本来の志に向かって\n邁進できる
entries.en:
Now those two
can charge full
speed ahead
toward what they
really set out to
do.

entries.jp: 近藤のオッサンも\n天国で喜んどるに\n違いないぜよ
entries.en:
I bet old man
Kondo's up in
heaven grinnin'
about it too!

entries.jp: 近藤か……
entries.en: Kondo, huh...

entries.jp: たしかにそうかもな
entries.en: Yeah, maybe\nyou're right.

entries.jp: めでたい時は酒じゃ！\n祝杯をあげるぜよ
entries.en: Happy times call\nfor sake! Let's\nraise a toast!

entries.jp: 当の本人も\nいないのにか？
entries.en: With the guys\nthemselves not\neven here?

entries.jp: そこが寂しいところじゃな\nまあ仕方がないぜよ\nわしらだけでも祝杯を
entries.en:
That's the sad
part, sure. Well,
can't be helped!
We'll just toast on
our own!

entries.jp: お前　酒が飲みたい\nだけじゃねえか……
entries.en: You just want a\ndrink, don't you...

entries.jp: まあまあ　晋作\n今日くらいは\nいいじゃない
entries.en: Now, now,\nShinsaku. Just for\ntoday, why not?

entries.jp: お龍～！\n幾松～！\nおうの～！
entries.en: Oryooo!\nIkumatsuuu!\nOunooo!

entries.jp: 誰でもいいから\n酒を持ってきてくれ～！
entries.en: Somebody,\nanybody, bring us\nsome sake!

entries.jp: なんだ？\n誰もいないのか？\n不用心だな
entries.en: What? Is nobody\nhere? How\ncareless.

entries.jp: 弥太郎！\n酒盛りをするぜよ
entries.en: Yataro! We're\nhavin' a drinking\nparty!

entries.jp: おかしいな\n呼んでも弥太郎が\nこないぜよ
entries.en: That's odd. I'm\ncallin' and Yataro\nain't comin'.

entries.jp: ちょっと奥を\n見てきましょうか
entries.en: Shall I go take a\nlook in the back?

entries.jp: そう言って厨房を覗いた\n桂が血相を変えて\n帰って来た
entries.en:
With that,
Katsura peeked
into the kitchen,
and came back
white as a sheet.

entries.jp: 大変です\n厨房で　お登勢さんが\n倒れています
entries.en:
This is terrible!
Otose-san has
collapsed in the
kitchen!

entries.jp: 何
entries.en: What!?

entries.jp: お登勢やん\nい　一体どうしたんじゃ？
entries.en: Otose-yan!\nWh-what in the\nworld happened?

entries.jp: うふふ……
entries.en: Hehehe...

entries.jp: 眠ってるみたいなんだけど\n揺すっても起きないんです
entries.en:
She seems to be
asleep, but she
won't wake up no
matter how I
shake her.

entries.jp: こんなとこで寝てると\n風邪を引くぜよ
entries.en: Sleepin' in a place\nlike this, you'll\ncatch a cold!

entries.jp: ……えへへへ
entries.en: ...Ehehehe.

entries.jp: ……だめだな
entries.en: ...No good.

entries.jp: 何か\n変なものでも食ったか？
entries.en: Did she eat\nsomething weird?

entries.jp: お登勢や～ん！
entries.en: Otose-yaaan!

entries.jp: 晋作も龍馬くんも\nどいて
entries.en: Shinsaku,\nRyoma-kun, move\naside.

entries.jp: 桂はお登勢の傍らに跪くと\n何かを確認するように\n瞼を開き　脈を取った
entries.en:
Katsura knelt at
Otose's side and,
as if checking for
something,
opened her
eyelids and took
her pulse.

entries.jp: 見たところ\n特に異常は無いようです\nただ随分と脈が弱い
entries.en:
From the look of
it, there's nothing
particularly
wrong. But her
pulse is very
weak.

entries.jp: 何かあって倒れたという\nよりも　衰弱して\n眠ってるっていう感じです
entries.en:
Rather than
collapsing from
something, it's
more like she's
weakened and
fallen asleep.

entries.jp: 徹夜で働き過ぎて\n倒れたのかな？
entries.en: Maybe she\nworked all night\nand keeled over?

entries.jp: わかりません\nでも　一応医者に\n診せた方がいいでしょう
entries.en:
I don't know. But
we'd better have a
doctor look at
her, just in case.

entries.jp: まずは奥に\n寝かせるべきだ\n手伝え　龍馬
entries.en:
First we should
lay her down in
the back. Give me
a hand, Ryoma.

entries.jp: お　おう
entries.en: R-right!

entries.jp:
お登勢を運ぼうと
奥の障子を開けると
そこにも二人
倒れている者がいた
entries.en:
When they slid
open the inner
shoji to carry
Otose through,
they found two
more people
collapsed there.

entries.jp: ……なっ
そこに転がる二人を見て\n龍馬と高杉は絶句する
entries.en:
At the sight of
the two sprawled
there, Ryoma and
Takasugi were
struck speechless.

entries.jp: うふふ……
entries.en: Hehehe...

entries.jp: ぁはは……
entries.en: Ahaha...

entries.jp: お登勢やんと同じじゃ\nこれはいったい\nどういうことぜよ？
entries.en:
Same as
Otose-yan! What
in the world is
goin' on here?

entries.jp: そういや\n幾松はどうしたんじゃ？
entries.en: Come to think of\nit, where's\nIkumatsu?

entries.jp: そうだ\n一人足りないぞ
entries.en: That's right.\nWe're one short.

entries.jp: 医者を呼びにいった？\nでも　草履はあるし
entries.en:
Did she go to
fetch a doctor?
But her sandals
are still here...

entries.jp: おーい　幾松\nどこぜよーー
entries.en: Heeey, Ikumatsu!\nWhere are ya?

entries.jp: ……けて
おい\n何か聞こえなかったか
entries.en: Hey. Did you hear\nsomething?

entries.jp: 奥の間の方ですね
entries.en: It came from the\ninner room.

entries.jp:
奥の間へ続く襖を
開けると　そこには
グッタリとした
幾松の姿があった
entries.en:
When they
opened the
sliding door to
the inner room,
there lay
Ikumatsu, limp.

entries.jp: 幾松\nお前は無事じゃったか！
entries.en: Ikumatsu! You're\nall right!

entries.jp: 良かった　皆さん……\n来てくれて……
entries.en: Thank goodness...\nyou all... came...

entries.jp: そのまま龍馬の腕に\n倒れ込む幾松
entries.en:
With that,
Ikumatsu
collapsed into
Ryoma's arms.

entries.jp:
倒れている者達を
布団に寝かせ　
龍馬達は意識が戻るのを
待った
entries.en:
Ryoma and the
others laid the
fallen in futons
and waited for
them to come to.

entries.jp: おかしいだろう
entries.en: Something's off.

entries.jp: 医者という医者を訪ねて\n門を叩いたが　誰も出て\nきやしねえ
entries.en:
I went to every
doctor in town
and banged on
their gates, but
not a single one
came out.

entries.jp: それだけじゃありません\n気付けを買いに薬屋に\n行ったけど誰もいない
entries.en:
That's not all. I
went to the
apothecary to buy
smelling salts, but
no one was there.

entries.jp: 近所も覗いてみたが\n皆　同じような状態で\n倒れていた
entries.en:
I checked on the
neighbors too.
They were all
collapsed the
same way.

entries.jp: 揺すっても叩いても\n誰も目を覚まさない\n返事すらしません
entries.en:
No matter how
much we shake
them or slap
them, no one
wakes up. They
don't even
answer.

entries.jp: わしらがいない間に\n何があったんじゃ
entries.en: What happened\nwhile we were\ngone?

entries.jp: おい　坂本！\n坂本はいるか
entries.en: Hey, Sakamoto! Is\nSakamoto here?

entries.jp: おい　土方だ\n坂本　高杉　桂！\nいるなら開けろ
entries.en:
It's Hijikata.
Sakamoto,
Takasugi,
Katsura! If you're
in there, open up.

entries.jp: おっ\nヒジゾーさんじゃ！
entries.en: Oh! It's Hijizo-san!

entries.jp: はいはい\nわしなら　おるぜ――\nむぐぐっ
entries.en: Yes, yes! I'm right\nhere-- Mmphh!

entries.jp: 気安く返事を\nするんじゃねえ！
entries.en: Don't go\nanswering so\ncasually!

entries.jp: 今の土方は幕府側の\n新選組なんだぞ！
entries.en: Hijikata's with the\nshogunate's\nShinsengumi now!

entries.jp: もがっ……テラーダに\n飯を食いに来ただけかも\nしれんじゃろ？
entries.en:
Mmph... Maybe he
just came to the
Terada to grab a
bite, y'know?

entries.jp: 表には本日休業の\n札を掛けてあります
entries.en: We've hung a\n"Closed Today"\nsign out front.

entries.jp: きっと\n腹が減ってるだけぜよ
entries.en: I bet he's just\nhungry!

entries.jp: お前はバカか？\n立場をよく考えろ！
entries.en: Are you an idiot?\nThink about\nwhere we stand!

entries.jp: とにかく\nじっとして何も言うな
entries.en: Anyway, stay still\nand don't say a\nword.

entries.jp: わ　わかったぜよ
entries.en: G-gotcha.

entries.jp: ……くっ\nもしやと様子を見に来たが\nやつらもやられたのか……
entries.en:
...Damn. I came to
check on them
just in case... Did
they get them
too...?

entries.jp: いや～　殺しても死なない\nような連中だもの\n隠れてるだけじゃない？
entries.en:
Nah~ Those guys
are the type you
couldn't kill if you
tried. Aren't they
just hiding?

entries.jp: どうして隠れる必要がある\n後ろ暗いところがなければ\nそんな必要はないだろう
entries.en:
Why would they
need to hide? If
they had nothing
to feel guilty
about, there'd be
no need.

entries.jp: 前に僕達　さんざん彼らを\n付け狙ったよね？\n忘れたの？　土方さん
entries.en:
We used to hunt
them down
relentlessly,
remember? Did
you forget,
Hijikata-san?

entries.jp: どうしろと言うんだ
entries.en: Then what do you\nwant me to do?

entries.jp: \fnt1出てこなければ\n斬り捨てる！\fnt0\nとでも言えばいいのか？
entries.en:
Should I say
something like,
 nt1"Come out, or I'll
cut you down!" nt0?

entries.jp: な……今……\n出てこなきゃ斬るって\n聞こえたぜよ
entries.en: Wh-- Just now... I\nheard "come out\nor I'll cut you"!

entries.jp: 絶対に出るなよ
entries.en: Don't you dare go\nout there.

entries.jp: さて　どうやって\n逃げ出そうか……
entries.en: Now, how do we\nescape...

entries.jp: もう　そんなんだから\nみんなに怖がられるんです
entries.en:
Honestly, that's
exactly why
everyone's scared
of you.

entries.jp: だったら\nなんて言えばいい
entries.en: Then what should\nI say?

entries.jp: こういう時は……
entries.en: At a time like\nthis...

entries.jp: 桂を呼ぶ
entries.en: Call Katsura

entries.jp: 龍馬を呼ぶ
entries.en: Call Ryoma

entries.jp: 高杉を呼ぶ
entries.en: Call Takasugi

entries.jp: メガネくんなら\nちゃんと話せばわかって\nくれるんじゃないかな？
entries.en:
Glasses-kun
would understand
if we just
explained
properly, don't
you think?

entries.jp: 確かに\nあの中では桂が\n一番冷静な男だ
entries.en:
True. Of those
guys, Katsura's
the most
level-headed.

entries.jp: ……よし
entries.en: ...All right.

entries.jp: 桂！　聞こえるか？\nお前達を捕まえに\n来たのではない！
entries.en:
Katsura! Can you
hear me? We
didn't come to
arrest you!

entries.jp: 話をしに来た！
entries.en: We came to talk!

entries.jp: 今　京で不可解な事件が\n起こってるんだ
entries.en:
Something
strange is going
on in Kyoto right
now.

entries.jp: もしかしたら\nメガネくんや　その仲間に\n心当たりないかなって
entries.en:
We thought
maybe you or
your friends
might know
something,
Glasses-kun.

entries.jp: 桂さん\nどうする？
entries.en: Katsura-san, what\ndo we do?

entries.jp: 確かに心当たりは\n存分にあります
entries.en: I certainly have\nplenty of ideas\nabout it.

entries.jp: これは協力できると\n見ていいでしょう
entries.en:
I think we can
take this as a
chance to
cooperate.

entries.jp: 捕まえるつもりだったら\n声なんかかけずに\n押し入ってきてるぜよ
entries.en:
If they meant to
arrest us, they'd
have barged in
without callin' out
first!

entries.jp: ……どうやら\n出てきてくれそうだね
entries.en: ...Looks like\nthey're coming\nout.

entries.jp: ちわ～す\n坂本さ～ん
entries.en: Delivery~!\nSakamoto-san~!

entries.jp: 牛丼の　なか吉屋です\n出前の牛丼大盛り\nお持ちしました～
entries.en:
It's Nakayoshiya
Beef Bowls! Here's
your large beef
bowl delivery~!

entries.jp: \fnt1ぎゅ\nぎゅ\n牛丼\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1B-b-beef bowl!\fnt0

entries.jp: バカ\n黙れ！
entries.en: Idiot! Shut up!

entries.jp: 桂さん\n龍馬を押さえつけろ！\n口を塞げ！
entries.en: Katsura-san! Hold\nRyoma down!\nCover his mouth!

entries.jp: あははは\nトサカくんは\n本当にバカだなぁ
entries.en:
Ahahaha!
Tosaka-kun, you
really are an
idiot.

entries.jp: いるのはわかってる\nお前達に話があってきた\nここを開けろ
entries.en:
I know you're in
there. We came to
talk to you. Open
up.

entries.jp: スカシく～ん\n死んでたら返事して
entries.en: Mr. Poseeer! If\nyou're dead,\nanswer me.

entries.jp: 死んでたら\n返事なんか出来るか\nお前はバカか
entries.en:
How am I
supposed to
answer if I'm
dead!? Are you an
idiot!?

entries.jp: ですって\n土方さん
entries.en: You heard him,\nHijikata-san.

entries.jp: 確実に\n中にいるようだな
entries.en: He's definitely in\nthere.

entries.jp: くそっ！\nオレ様としたことが
entries.en: Damn it! How\ncould yours truly\nslip up like that!

entries.jp: 二人とも　取り敢えず\n中に入ってくれますか？
entries.en: Would you two\ncome inside for\nnow?

entries.jp: ああ　よかった\nやっぱり　トサカくん達は\n無事だったんだ
entries.en:
Ah, what a relief.
I knew you guys
were okay,
Tosaka-kun.

entries.jp: どういう意味じゃ？
entries.en: What d'ya mean\nby that?

entries.jp: 今ね……\n京の都中の人々が\n謎の眠りについてるんだ
entries.en:
Right now...
people all over
Kyoto have fallen
into a mysterious
sleep.

entries.jp: 今日一日　新選組の\n隊士全員で　京中を\nかけずり回った
entries.en:
Every trooper in
the Shinsengumi
spent all day
today running
around Kyoto.

entries.jp: 何か\nわかったんか？
entries.en: Find out\nanything?

entries.jp: いや　何も掴めなかった\nその上　隊士の半分は\n帰ってこなかった……
entries.en:
No. We came up
empty. On top of
that, half the
troopers never
came back...

entries.jp: なんと\n新選組の隊士まで\nやられてしもうたんか
entries.en: What!? They got\nShinsengumi\ntroopers too!?

entries.jp: お前達　何か知らないか？\nどんな小さなことでもいい
entries.en:
Do you know
anything? Even
the smallest thing
will do.

entries.jp: そうは\n言われてもなぁ……
entries.en: Even if ya say\nthat...

entries.jp: 流行り病なんじゃ\nないか？
entries.en: Isn't it just some\nepidemic?

entries.jp: それにしては広まるのが\n早すぎるし　僕達も\n眠ってなきゃおかしい
entries.en:
It's spreading way
too fast for that.
And then we'd
have to be asleep
too.

entries.jp: 確かに……
entries.en: That's true...

entries.jp: ううっ……
entries.en: Uuuh...

entries.jp: あれ\nその子は……？
entries.en: Huh? That girl\nis...?

entries.jp: そうじゃ！\n幾松が何かを\n知ってるかもしれん！
entries.en: That's it!\nIkumatsu might\nknow somethin'!

entries.jp: 可能性はありますね
entries.en: It's possible.

entries.jp: みんなが倒れてる中　\n幾松さんだけは\n意識がありましたし
entries.en:
With everyone
else collapsed,
Ikumatsu-san
alone was still
conscious.

entries.jp: 幾松さん　幾松さん……\n起きられそうですか？
entries.en:
Ikumatsu-san,
Ikumatsu-san... Do
you think you can
get up?

entries.jp: 桂さん……\nそれに坂本さんに……\n高杉さん……
entries.en:
Katsura-san... and
Sakamoto-san...
and
Takasugi-san...

entries.jp: な……\n新選組も……
entries.en: Wh... The\nShinsengumi too...

entries.jp: ちぇ\nずいぶんと嫌われた\nもんだね
entries.en: Tch. Sure got\nourselves hated,\nhuh.

entries.jp: 幾松\n起きてすぐで悪いが\n話は出来るか？
entries.en:
Ikumatsu, sorry
to push when
you've just woken
up, but can you
talk?

entries.jp: は……\nはい……
entries.en: Y... yes...

entries.jp: わしらが留守にしていた間\n何が起こったか教えてくれ
entries.en: Tell us what\nhappened while\nwe were away.

entries.jp: そう言われても……\n私もさっぱり……
entries.en: Even if you ask\nme... I have no\nidea either...

entries.jp: この京に住まう人々の\nほとんどが死んだように\n眠っている
entries.en:
Most of the
people living in
Kyoto are asleep
like the dead.

entries.jp: 見ろ\n目を覚ましたのは\nお前だけだ
entries.en: Look. You're the\nonly one who\nwoke up.

entries.jp: お龍姐さん……\nおうの……\nお登勢さんまで……
entries.en: Sis Oryo... Ouno...\neven Otose-san...

entries.jp: そんな……
entries.en: No...

entries.jp: うそ……起きて……\nねぇ……起きてよ……
entries.en: No... wake up...\ncome on... please\nwake up...

entries.jp:
しかし
いくら幾松が
声をかけようが
揺すろうが
誰も返事をしない
entries.en:
But no matter
how Ikumatsu
called to them or
shook them, no
one answered.

entries.jp: 覚えているだけでいい\n何でもいいから\n話してくれない？
entries.en:
Just what you
remember is fine.
Anything at all.
Won't you tell us?

entries.jp: そうじゃ　お前さん\nなんで奥座敷で\n倒れてたんじゃ？
entries.en:
That's right,
ma'am. How come
you were out cold
in the back room?

entries.jp: それは…………\nあっ……
entries.en: That's... Oh...

entries.jp: 思い当たることが\nあるようだな
entries.en: Looks like\nsomething comes\nto mind.

entries.jp: あれは確か……\n夜明け前の事でした……
entries.en: I think it was...\njust before\ndawn...

entries.jp: う～ん\nムニャムニャ
entries.en: Mmmm... mumble\nmumble...

entries.jp: あいたっ……！

もう……おうのは本当に
寝相が悪いんだから……
おかげで目が覚め
ちゃった……
entries.en:
Honestly... Ouno
is such a terrible
sleeper... Now I'm
wide awake.

entries.jp: ぐぁ～ごぉ～\nぐぁ～ごぉ～
entries.en: Ghaaa... ghooo...\nGhaaa... ghooo...

entries.jp: お龍姐さんも大口開けて\n……またいびきかいてるし…
entries.en:
And Sis Oryo's
sleeping with her
mouth wide
open... snoring
again...

entries.jp: なんだか私も喉が\n渇いてきたわ……
entries.en: I'm getting kind\nof thirsty too...

entries.jp: うっ……何これ……\n耳鳴り……？
entries.en: Ugh... what is\nthis...? Ringing in\nmy ears...?

entries.jp: ……淋しい\n淋しいよ
entries.en: ...I'm lonely... so\nlonely...

entries.jp: だ　誰の声……？
entries.en: Wh-whose voice is\nthat...?

entries.jp: 悲しいよ\n寂しいよ\n一人はイヤだよ……
entries.en: I'm sad... I'm\nlonely... I don't\nwant to be alone...

entries.jp: うっ……\nこれは天歌……？\nどこから聴こえてくるの…？
entries.en:
Ugh... Is this the
Heaven's Song...?
Where is it
coming from...?

entries.jp: 誰か　話を聞いてよ……\n誰でもいい……\n誰でも……
entries.en:
Someone, please
listen to me...
Anyone... Anyone
at all...

entries.jp: それから先は意識が無くて\n……気がついたら\n奥座敷に倒れていたの……
entries.en:
After that, I lost
consciousness...
and when I came
to, I was lying in
the back room...

entries.jp: 不思議な声と\n天歌ですか……
entries.en: A mysterious\nvoice, and the\nHeaven's Song...

entries.jp: だが井伊はもういないぜ\n一体　誰が天歌を
entries.en:
But Ii's gone now.
So who the hell is
singing the
Heaven's Song?

entries.jp: しかし　どうして\n幾松だけが\n無事じゃったんじゃ？
entries.en:
But how come
Ikumatsu was the
only one who
came through
fine?

entries.jp: それは多分……\n桂さんにもらった\nこれのおかげかも……
entries.en:
That's probably...
thanks to these
that Katsura-san
gave me...

entries.jp: そう言って\n幾松は懐から\n耳栓を取り出す
entries.en:
With that,
Ikumatsu took a
pair of earplugs
from the fold of
her kimono.

entries.jp: 耳栓？\nなんで　こんなものを\n持っとるんじゃ？
entries.en:
Earplugs? Now
why would you be
carryin' somethin'
like that?

entries.jp: お龍姐さんのいびきが\n酷いから……\n桂さんから借りてたの……
entries.en:
Because Sis Oryo
snores so
terribly... I
borrowed them
from
Katsura-san...

entries.jp: とても悲しそうな\n声だった……\n不安そうな子供の――
entries.en: It was such a sad\nvoice... like a\nfrightened child--

entries.jp: 子供……？
entries.en: A child...?

entries.jp: どうした\n土方
entries.en: What is it,\nHijikata?

entries.jp: いや　しかし\nまさかな……
entries.en: No. But... it\ncouldn't be...

entries.jp: 何か思い当たることが\nあるなら　教えてくれ\n土方
entries.en:
If something
comes to mind,
spit it out,
Hijikata.

entries.jp: 慶喜様……
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama...

entries.jp: 何だと
entries.en: What did you say?

entries.jp: 俺も近藤さんの\n付き添いでチラリと\nお顔を拝見したくらいだが
entries.en:
I only caught a
glimpse of him
myself, once,
when I went with
Kondo-san...

entries.jp: まだ　お若い方だった\n若いと言うよりも\nまさに幼子だ
entries.en:
But he was still
young. Not just
young. A small
child, truly.

entries.jp: 確かに代替わりした\nばかりだけど　そんなに\n若かったんですね……
entries.en:
It's true he only
just took over, but
I had no idea he
was that young...

entries.jp: 確かめにいかなくちゃ\nならんぜよ
entries.en: Then we gotta go\nfind out for sure,\nI tell ya.

entries.jp: 確かめるって\nなにをだ？
entries.en: Find out what?

entries.jp: 決まっとる\nその悲しげな子供の声が\n将軍様の声かどうかじゃ
entries.en:
Ain't it obvious?
Whether that sad
child's voice
belongs to the
shogun!

entries.jp: おい　お前は\n何を言っているのか\nわかってるのか？
entries.en: Hey. Do you even\nunderstand what\nyou're saying?

entries.jp: 井伊が去り\n弱体化したとはいえ\n相手は幕府の将軍だぞ！
entries.en:
Ii may be gone
and the
shogunate weaker
for it, but this is
the shogun!

entries.jp: だからなんじゃ？
entries.en: So what?

entries.jp: 目も鼻も口も耳も\nついとるヤツなんじゃろ？
entries.en:
He's still a fella
with eyes, a nose,
a mouth and ears,
ain't he?

entries.jp: もし将軍様が寂しいと\n言ってるなら　わしの\nロックを聴かせてやるぜよ
entries.en:
If the shogun's
sayin' he's lonely,
then I'll just have
to let him hear
my rock!

entries.jp: 驚いた\nトサカくんはバカなのか\n大物なのか……
entries.en:
Wow. I can't tell if
Tosaka-kun is an
idiot or a really
big deal...

entries.jp: まあ　ここまで来れば\nそろそろ大物ってことで\nいいんじゃないですか
entries.en:
Well, after
making it this far,
I think we can call
him a big deal by
now, don't you?

entries.jp: しかし　どうやって\n将軍に会う？
entries.en: Still, how do we\nget to see the\nshogun?

entries.jp: 二条城に踏み入るのか？\nさすがの勝先生も\nかばっちゃくれねえぞ
entries.en:
Storm Nijo Castle?
Not even
Katsu-sensei will
cover for us this
time.

entries.jp: それとも　忍び込む？\nでも城ともなると\nそう簡単にはいかないですよ
entries.en:
Or sneak in? But
a castle won't be
that simple, you
know.

entries.jp: それでなくたって\nキミ達はお尋ね者なんだ
entries.en: Besides, you guys\nare wanted men.

entries.jp: 僕らと一緒に行動すること\n自体が難しいと思うけど
entries.en:
I'd say even
moving around
together with us
is going to be
tricky.

entries.jp: 将軍様に会うにしても\nわしら全員揃ってなければ\n意味がないぜよ
entries.en:
Even if we see
the shogun, it
don't mean a
thing unless all of
us are there
together!

entries.jp: それだ！
entries.en: That's it!

entries.jp: 何かいい考えでも\n思いついたのか？
entries.en: You thought of\nsomething good?

entries.jp: 土方さん\n私達を捕まえてください！
entries.en: Hijikata-san,\nplease arrest us!

entries.jp: セ　センセー\n考えすぎて　おかしく\nなってしまったのか？
entries.en:
S-Sensei... did all
that thinkin'
finally make you
crack?

entries.jp: し　失礼だな\nおかしくなんて\nなってません！
entries.en: H-how rude! I\nhave not cracked!

entries.jp: なるほど\n桂の考えはわかった
entries.en: I see. I get what\nKatsura has in\nmind.

entries.jp: 俺と総司が\nお前達三人を捕らえ\n二条城に連行する
entries.en:
Soji and I capture
you three and
haul you to Nijo
Castle.

entries.jp: そういう筋書きか\n俺達の立場を逆手に\n取った　うまい手だ
entries.en:
That's the script,
is it? Turning our
position to our
advantage. Smart
move.

entries.jp: これなら怪しまれずに\n私達全員が揃ったまま\n二条城に入れるはずです
entries.en:
This way, we
should be able to
enter Nijo Castle
all together
without raising
suspicion.

entries.jp: どうする\n坂本\n高杉
entries.en: Well? Sakamoto.\nTakasugi.

entries.jp: まかり間違えば\n二条城に入る前に斬首――\nということもありうるが
entries.en:
One wrong step,
and you could be
beheaded before
you even reach
Nijo Castle.

entries.jp: 忘れたのか？\nオレ様達は\nロックンローラーだぜ
entries.en:
Forgot already?
The great
Takasugi and co.
are rock 'n'
rollers.

entries.jp: ノるか　ソるかは\n望むところだ\nなあ　龍馬
entries.en:
All or nothing?
That's just how
yours truly likes
it. Right, Ryoma?

entries.jp: 斬首は怖いが\nそれしかないなら\nそれしかないぜよ
entries.en:
Gettin' beheaded's
scary, but if that's
the only way,
then that's the
only way!

entries.jp: わしは　センセーや\nヒジゾーさんを信じる\nだけじゃ
entries.en:
I'm just gonna
believe in Sensei
and Hijizo-san,
that's all!

entries.jp: 井伊が死んで　天歌の\n脅威はなくなったと\n思っていたが
entries.en:
I thought that
with Ii dead, the
threat of the
Heaven's Song
was gone.

entries.jp: どうやら　そうでは\nなさそうだ
entries.en: Apparently not.

entries.jp: 今の京の状態は\n近藤さんが目指した\n世の中とは言えん
entries.en:
The state of
Kyoto now is not
the world
Kondo-san was
striving for.

entries.jp: 新選組　局長としても\n見過ごすわけにはいかん
entries.en: As Commander of\nthe Shinsengumi,\nI can't let it pass.

entries.jp: 俺の方からも頼む\n協力して欲しい
entries.en: I'm asking you\ntoo. I want your\nhelp.

entries.jp: わしらは仲間じゃろ\n頭を下げる必要なんて\nないぜよ
entries.en:
We're comrades,
ain't we? No need
to bow your head
to us!

entries.jp: 斬首になったらなったで\n首から上だけでも\nロックは歌えるかな？
entries.en:
And if I do get
beheaded, I
wonder if I can
still sing rock
with just my
head?

entries.jp: 龍馬くんなら\n歌えそうですねぇ
entries.en: If anyone could,\nRyoma-kun, it'd\nbe you.

entries.jp: 首を切り落としたら\n少しはバカが治るかもな
entries.en:
Maybe chopping
your head off
would cure a little
of that stupidity.

entries.jp: シンディ！\nそら酷いぜよ
entries.en: Shindy! That's\njust cruel!

entries.jp: ……ありがとう
entries.en: ...Thank you.

entries.jp: この土方歳三\n何が何でもお前達を――
entries.en:
I, Toshizo
Hijikata, will get
you through this
no matter what--

entries.jp: いや　俺達全員で\n将軍の前に立つと\n約束しよう
entries.en:
No. I promise all
of us will stand
before the
shogun together.

entries.jp: 頼んだぜよ\nヒジゾーさん
entries.en: Countin' on ya,\nHijizo-san!

entries.jp: 早速　準備を始めよう\n総司　戻るぞ！
entries.en:
We'll start
preparing right
away. Soji, we're
going back!

entries.jp: はいっ\n土方さん！
entries.en: Yes, Hijikata-san!

entries.jp: 改めて捕まえに来るから\n首を洗って待っててね～
entries.en:
I'll come back to
arrest you
properly, so scrub
your necks and
wait for me~

entries.jp: 土方と沖田は　早足で\nテラーダを出て行った
entries.en: Hijikata and Okita\nhurried out of the\nTerada.

entries.jp: ちっ\n沖田の野郎\n笑えねえ冗談だぜ……
entries.en: Tch. That Okita...\nThat joke isn't\nfunny...
